opinions.text:
United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion that cer-tiorari should be granted, the judgment of the Court of Appeals reversed and the case remanded to the District Court for a jury trial.
